messages.body: todas as imagens tem que ser coloridas. fica dificil de ver quem é quem com ela preto e branca. e vamos adicionar uma animação para quando se seleciona alguém. aqui está o link de um vídeo de referencia. https://x.com/desdivj/status/2123350429035872573?a=4TVWeFzCym_o7cmY6w4&s=20

Every face in the lists is in full color now (the grayscale for people not yet picked is gone). Picking someone plays a flight modeled on the reference: the face lifts out of its row on an arc, grows to its new size and lands with a small bounce in the row of faces (Team Owners and Team Managers) or in the Team Owner card of the Create a Team form. Shared in _teams/flyFace.ts; off with reduced motion.
